title: 1.3 Which time actually works?
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
goal: Use a work interval and explicit before/after relationships to select a workable time and distinguish the order events happen from the order they are mentioned.
grammar_function: Move from two separate event times to an interval, then from a familiar event label to a complete event clause. Interpret the temporal relationship even when the later event is mentioned first, then apply it to the agreed visit.
prerequisite: 1.1–1.2 leave/start/finish/arrive home and event-time reports A1 first/then, whole hours and known work/lunch/dinner
speaking_outcome: Keep from/to and before/after intelligible within complete phrases; phrase grouping must not make the first-mentioned event sound automatically first in time.
